title: Adobe: a 9% owner cash yield, priced for no growth
debate: Bears say generative AI commoditises creative tools. Net new ARR fell 36% as Adobe went freemium; Wells Fargo and HSBC downgraded in October.
view: Growth is intact. Q3 revenue +13%, total ARR +11%, and AI-first ARR above $650M, up 150%.
Reach is widening. About 1B monthly users; freemium users +70% feed Firefly and Acrobat upgrades.
The buyback is huge. $24.6B of capacity is 26% of the market cap; at $247 it retires ~9% of shares a year.
wrong: Net new ARR keeps falling through FY27, or the new CEO (from 1 Dec) trades margin for growth without a payback.
foot: Base: 14x FY27E owner FCF/share; bear: 8x after a 10% FCF fall; bull: 18x. Sources: Adobe Q3 FY26 8-K and 10-Q.

title: Intuit: the small-business ledger at 10x free cash flow
debate: Bears say AI agents will file taxes for free. TurboTax units fell 2%, and FY27 revenue growth slows to 9–10% from 14%.
view: TurboTax is a quarter of sales. The business platform, 54%, grew 18%; QuickBooks Online Accounting +23%.
QuickBooks is the system of record for small firms and their accountants; agents need its ledger and payroll data.
Cost cuts and cash return. FY27 GAAP margin rises to 32%; FY26 returned $6.8B, 8% of today’s market cap.
wrong: TurboTax loses share again in the 2027 season despite AI-native filing, or QuickBooks growth slips below 10%.
foot: Half size after a 13% rally since 6 Oct; add below $300. FY26 FCF includes a tax benefit; on FY27E the yield is 7.1%.

title: GoDaddy: a 10% owner cash yield on a domain toll road
debate: Bears say AI search and AI site builders shrink small-business web presence. A .com promotion hurt bookings; RBC downgraded on AI risk (12 Oct).
view: Domains are identity. Businesses, and now AI agents, need them; the .com/.net base grew 5% in Q2.
Cash flow is still rising. About $1.8B of 2026 FCF is guided, up ~12%; that covers net debt in 1.5 years.
Buybacks, plus a possible bid. Buybacks retire ~13% of shares a year; Gen Digital made an unsolicited approach (FT, 24 Sep).
wrong: Bookings keep lagging revenue into 2027, or AI builders take the website and marketing add-ons that drive margins.
foot: Base: 10x 2027E owner FCF/share; bear: 6x after a 15% FCF fall; bull: 14x. Sources: GoDaddy Q2-26 8-K, Verisign Q2-26.
